lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Boaz went up to the town gate and sat down there. The guardian-redeemer whom Boaz had mentioned came along. Boaz called him to sit.

lines.speaker: boaz
lines.text: Naomi, who has come back from Moab, is selling the piece of land that belonged to our relative Elimelek. I thought I should speak to you about it in the presence of the elders of my people.

lines.speaker: boaz
lines.text: On the day you buy the land from Naomi, you also acquire Ruth the Moabite, the dead man's widow, in order to maintain the name of the dead with his property.

lines.speaker: kinsman_redeemer
lines.text: I cannot redeem it because I might endanger my own estate. You redeem it yourself. I cannot do it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The witnesses were assembled. The transaction was made before the town elders. Boaz presented the redemption choice clearly and without pressure.

choices.label: Present the witnesses
choices.note: The elders confirm the matter before the community.

choices.label: Accept the redemption
choices.note: Boaz takes responsibility for Ruth and Naomi's inheritance.
